routing: Accept compiled no_water_contact only if margin>=0.30 and distance_dry<=1.0; all other states require native semantic interpretation. Geometry mismatch invalidates compiled result.
semantic_rubric: Inspect target polygon and surrounding physical context, excluding numeric or text overlays.

water_contact: visible standing/river water inundates target pavement; road markings/pavement texture disappear under consistent connected water surface; reflections/ripples support but alone do not prove inundation.

no_water_contact: exposed target pavement is visibly identifiable through markings, joints, curb relations, textured surface; rain-wet or stained pavement is not classified as inundated merely by color.
unknown: mixed partial coverage, obstruction, glare, insufficient geometry, or evidence cannot decide. Never turn an abstention into a guess.
Same exact2024 polygons applied in2023; if camera geometry moved and does not identify same asset, mark geometry_valid=false and unknown.
baseline: Included native semantic vision on ALL sample frames, blind to compiled predictions and evaluator. Hybrid merges a subset afterward.
development_exposure: v1 calibration12frames and24 evaluator outcomes only. v1 original failures retained.
extra_reporting: Wet and dry conditional coverage separately; no gate relaxed.
